'''Samaha''' is a village in [[Ghealdan]].

==Activities==
[[Rand al'Thor]] passed through the village of Samaha on his way to [[Tear]]. [[Moiraine Damodred]], [[Lan Mandragoran]], [[Perrin Aybara]] and [[Loial]] passed through after him and learned that after he left, every well in the village had gone dry.{{ref/book|3|33}}
